claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_received_hit_window
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fire Shield deals retaliatory damage to any attacker who lands a melee hit on the caster. This requires a window that opens when the caster *receives* a melee attack hit — the inverse of the existing on_hit_window (which fires when the caster lands a hit). No v4 atom covers this direction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes 2d8 Fire damage from a warm shield or 2d8 Cold damage from a chill shield.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance (OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fire Shield grants the caster Resistance to Cold or Fire damage for the spell's duration. The v4 atom grant_resistance exists, but OngoingOperation in types.ts only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit — no grant_resistance variant. The resistance is the other half of the spell's persistent effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The warm shield grants you Resistance to Cold damage, and the chill shield grants you Resistance to Fire damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: retaliatory_damage (OngoingOperation or EffectTarget variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The retaliatory damage targets the attacker (not the caster, not a designated target). The existing damage effect atom targets within the attachment scope. A retaliatory damage operation needs to express that the damage target is the creature that triggered the on_received_hit_window, which is directionally opposite to the normal attachment flow.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The attacker takes 2d8 Fire damage from a warm shield or 2d8 Cold damage from a chill shield.
